summary: Remove one or more class tokens with DOMTokenList validation and undefined return.

semantics.absent: removing absent valid token is no-op
semantics.validation: empty token => SyntaxError; ASCII whitespace => InvalidCharacterError

tests.name: removes requested tokens
tests.input: const e=document.createElement('div'); e.className='a b c'; e.classList.remove('a','c'); console.log(e.className);
